title: Unified Robust and Convergent Over-The-Air Federated Learning under Channel Noise and Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2503.19549v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a key enabler of distributed model training across ubiquitous wireless edge devices while preserving data privacy in next-generation wireless systems. One communication-efficient approach to realize this is leveraging Over-the-Air Federated Learning (OTA-FL), which exploits the superposition property of wireless multiple access channels (MAC) to perform low-latency model aggregation. translated_title: 信道噪声与异构性下统一鲁棒且收敛的空中联邦学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）已成为在下一代无线系统中实现跨无处不在的无线边缘设备进行分布式模型训练、同时保护数据隐私的关键使能技术。实现这一目标的一种通信高效方法是利用空中联邦学习（OTA-FL），它利用无线多址信道（MAC）的叠加特性来执行低延迟的模型聚合。然而，实际的OTA-FL部署会受到服务器端信道噪声、衰落以及参与边缘设备之间数据异构性与系统异构性等联合效应的显著影响，这些效应会降低模型性能并进而影响收敛性。在本工作中，我们提出了新颖的鲁棒且收敛的联邦学习框架RoCo-FL，用于在联邦无线网络中联合应对上述挑战。RoCo-FL通过非精确优化来构建本地更新，以捕捉……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了RoCo-FL框架，通过基于非精确优化的本地更新设计，统一应对空中联邦学习中服务器信道噪声、信道衰落以及数据与系统异构性对模型性能和收敛性的联合影响。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RoCo-FL, a novel framework that unifies robustness and convergence in over-the-air federated learning by formulating local updates through inexact optimization to jointly handle server-side channel noise, fading, and data and system heterogeneity.
